title: Beehiiv creators are buzzing about a new price increase
summary: Beehiiv, a creator platform that has risen in popularity as an alternative to Substack, is increasing its prices - and many users aren't happy. In a post explaining the increase, Beehiiv co-founder and CEO Tyler Denk says it will allow the company to "continue investing in our core platform experience."
